newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka MP wounded, bodyguard killed in shooting.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka MP wounded, bodyguard killed in shooting.

text.p: Unknown gunmen shot and wounded a member of parliament from Sri Lanka's ruling Peoples' Alliance and killed one of his bodyguards on Tuesday, police and hospital officials said.
Lawmaker Nalanda Ellawala was shot in southern Sri Lanka when he went to submit his political group's nominations for local elections due in March, police said.
The shooting occurred in the town of Kuruwita, 80 km (50 miles) south of Colombo, police said.
Police said no arrests had yet been made.
Ellawala was taken to a local hospital where he was reported in serious condition, hospital officials said.
Local elections are tentatively scheduled for March 27, the first test of President Chandrika Kumaratunga's government which came to power in general and presidential elections in 1994.
